elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c) warrants only that services will be performed “in conformity with this Agreement”; it does not impose a professional-and-workmanlike standard.

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: HDI warrants that the Site and any delivered software will conform in all material respects to applicable documentation.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The software conformance warranty applies for twelve months following delivery.
The services warranty applies for ninety days following performance.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: At the Company’s election, HDI must repair or replace non-conforming software or services.
The Company may elect a refund of fees paid for the non-conforming software or services.

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: No HDI warranty of compliance with applicable laws is included; the corporate-status representations do not establish operational legal compliance.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no warranty concerning malicious code.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Software is warranted to conform to applicable documentation for twelve months, exceeding 90 days.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: Services are warranted to conform to the Agreement for ninety days, exceeding 30 days.
